question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Apple of discord
solution:
The correct answer is **'Bone of contention'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'Apple of discord'** means the foundation, root or core of a quarrel or a small issue that could lead to a bigger argument. (लड़ाई का कारण)
 
• It is used to describe any object or issue that causes rivalry, disagreement, or conflict among people.
 
 
• **Example:** *I sense an **apple of discord **between you two.*
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that **'Bone of contention'** is the most appropriate meaning of **'Apple of discord'.**
 
 
• **Example:** *The boundary line between the countries was a **bone of contention** between the two countries.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'Bone of contention'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Practical:** It refers to actually doing something rather than with ideas or thought. (प्रायोगिक)
 
• **Distant love:** It refers to relationship between partners who are geographically separated from one another. (दूर का प्यार)
 
• **Centre of attraction:** It describes a person, object, or location that attracts the most attention or interest. (आकर्षण का केंद्र)
